title: Rationalization (scalar localization)
statement:
For the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], fix a prime
$\ell\neq p$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], a scheme $Y$, and a uniformizer
$\varpi_E$ of its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$. The derived-complete
integral category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] is
$D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$, built from the finite-torsion coefficients
[def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] $A_{E,n}=\mathcal
O_E/\varpi_E^n$; it is an $\mathcal O_E$-linear triangulated category with $\mathcal O_E$-linear shift [lem-weil-integral-constructible-triangulated, lem-weil-integral-constructible-linear]. If $\mathcal C$ is an $\mathcal O_E$-linear triangulated
category, its rationalization $\mathcal C[1/\varpi_E]$ is its scalar localization at $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization]: it has the same objects
and, for $K,L\in\mathcal C$,

$$
 \Hom_{\mathcal C[1/\varpi_E]}(K,L)
 =\Hom_{\mathcal C}(K,L)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E,
$$

with the induced shift, and with distinguished triangles those isomorphic to images of distinguished triangles of $\mathcal C$; this makes $\mathcal C[1/\varpi_E]$ a triangulated category and $\mathcal C\to\mathcal C[1/\varpi_E]$ an exact functor [lem-weil-linear-scalar-localization-triangulated]. Set

$$
 D^b_c(Y,E)=
 D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)[1/\varpi_E].
$$

No Karoubi (idempotent) completion is taken in this definition: the notation
$\mathcal C[1/\varpi_E]$ denotes the raw scalar localization displayed above,
in which no idempotent is formally adjoined. For $E=\Ql$, this uses $\mathcal
O_E=\Zl$ and $\varpi_E=\ell$.

If $E\subset L$ is a finite extension, the scalar-extension functor is

$$
 -\otimes_E L:D^b_c(Y,E)\longrightarrow D^b_c(Y,L),
$$

defined on integral representatives by the integral scalar extension
$K\mapsto K\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L$ [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] (completed derived tensor product with $\mathcal O_L$, levelwise modulo powers of the
two uniformizers), which carries $D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ into $D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_L)$ [lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-constructible], followed by rationalization: on objects $K\mapsto K\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L$, and on morphisms $f\otimes a\mapsto(f\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L)\otimes a$ for $f\in\Hom(K,M)$, $a\in E\subset L$, which is well defined because integral scalar extension is $\mathcal O_E$-linear.

proof.text: Specialize the existing raw tensor-Hom ScalarLocalization to sfIntegralConstructibleCategory. Its linear shift and triangulation are the currently recorded intrinsic structures, and exists_triangulated_scalarLocalization supplies the existing induced shift, image triangles and exact localization. These definitions and their signatures are preserved.

For sfRationalHomCoordinates_existsUnique, tensor the canonical coefficient algebra equivalence with the identity on the integral Hom module, and then commute the tensor factors. TensorProduct.congr and TensorProduct.comm give an additive equivalence with the required pure-tensor formula. Two candidates agree at zero, on each pure tensor by that formula, and on sums by additivity; tensor induction and AddEquiv.ext prove uniqueness.

Let F be the actual restricted completed integral scalar extension and phi the restriction of the field embedding to the valuation rings. Additivity descends through the full subcategory. The scalar-action equality in sfIntegralConstructible_linear and sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension_smul prove that F is phi-semilinear. The source uniformizer is a unit in the source localization, hence in E and then in L under the field embedding. Transporting back through the target coefficient equivalence proves that phi sends it to a unit in the target localization. The coefficientMap_unique clause of the generic semilinear-localization interface identifies its coefficient map with the source field equivalence followed by the embedding and the inverse target field equivalence: after the target equivalence both maps agree on all integral scalars.

Apply the existing generic semilinear ScalarLocalization.extension to F and phi. Its object map is literally the required integral image. The chosen extensionHom has the pure-tensor formula by existsUnique_semilinearHom; the coefficient-map equality from the preceding step makes this exactly the formula in sfRationalScalarExtension_existsUnique. The generic extensionAdditive gives additivity. For uniqueness, use Functor.ext with the prescribed object equalities. On pure tensors the two map values are heterogeneously equal by their specified formulas, and conj_eqToHom_iff_heq converts this into the required transported equality. The zero case follows from additive functoriality; the sum case uses map_add and bilinearity of composition with the endpoint equality morphisms. Tensor induction closes the general case, proving equality of functors.

split_report.summary: Checked against the master blueprint text (no slopmaster2 counterpart, no Lean). The source explicitly takes NO Karoubi completion (raw scalar localization Hom ⊗_{O_E} E), contrary to the node title and the lead's one-line description; kept as in the source, so def-weil-karoubi-envelope is not a dependency. Split by one level: the scalar localization of an R-linear category (new def-weil-linear-scalar-localization), its triangulated structure, which the source leaves implicit but downstream nodes use (new lem-weil-linear-scalar-localization-triangulated, added to the statement), the O_E-linearity of D^b_c(Y,O_E) required by the source's hypothesis (new lem-weil-integral-constructible-linear; triangulatedness cites lem-weil-integral-constructible-triangulated), the integral scalar extension K ↦ Rlim_m Res_m(K ⊗^L_{O_E} O_L/ϖ_L^m) (new def-weil-integral-scalar-extension) and its preservation of D^b_c (new lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-constructible). def-weil-derived-tensor removed from stmt_deps (it is over a constant ring; the completed tensor product is now in def-weil-integral-scalar-extension); def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension added. The action on morphisms of -⊗_E L was written out.
